subject.title: feat(memory): graduate sessionMemory from experimental — solve the multi-session continuity problem

question: Should OpenClaw graduate session transcript indexing from `experimental.sessionMemory` to a stable or default-on memory behavior, and under what privacy/source-policy contract?
rationale: Source inspection can prove the feature remains opt-in, but it cannot decide the privacy, retrieval precedence, QMD export, embedding cost, and upgrade-default tradeoffs for all users.

options.title: Keep Experimental Until Blockers Close
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the open session-source, duplicate-indexing, ranking, privacy, and docs/cost blockers to be resolved before changing defaults.

options.title: Graduate Stable Opt-In
options.body: Remove the experimental framing only after documenting source labels and privacy/cost behavior, while keeping transcript indexing explicit and default-off.

options.title: Default On For New Installs
options.body: Enable session transcript indexing for new installs only after maintainers accept the storage, indexing, visibility, and privacy tradeoffs.

recommendation.title: Keep Experimental Until Blockers Close
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the open session-source, duplicate-indexing, ranking, privacy, and docs/cost blockers to be resolved before changing defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the experimental session-memory source and has the deepest sampled history in the central memory-search implementation; final policy should still involve broader maintainer review.
